action_summary: A capability nothing has ever run can verify itself by running. Measured at 0875df1c: 138 of 141 bound rows were UNVERIFIED, and executing all 136 resolvable ones showed 87 RAN, 40 MISSING_DEPENDENCY, 8 NEEDS_INPUT, 1 FAILED and ZERO structurally broken -- they were unverified because nobody had run them, not because they did not work. The record binds module identity, environment identity and observed outcome, so it goes STALE when either moves, and a re-run is the only thing that re-earns it. The creature now probes a bounded number per pulse inside sense_reality, memoized so a warm workspace pays nothing.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Three routes were measured and rejected before this one. The receipt lane was tried first as the obvious oracle: 12 sampled adapters produced 0 receipts at 845 ms each, because it requires exit 0 plus JSON on stdout. Pinning module bytes at run time was then rejected as circular -- it would read FRESH forever regardless of behaviour. Withdrawing the 42 missing-dependency rows was rejected as the mirror image of an error already ruled out, since a missing optional dependency is a fact about the host.

falsification_condition: Any of: (a) editing a module after its run does NOT make it STALE; (b) changing the environment does NOT make it STALE; (c) a failed run counts as FRESH; (d) the budget is not honoured; (e) already-observed rows are re-probed forever; (f) a probe writes into the tree it measures; (g) a broken probe stops the pulse; (h) the registry file is modified by the observer.
